answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation-based Sybil resistance mechanism, where agents stake tokens to participate in validation. An attacker creating multiple fake identities, akin to building a large sandcastle on a knoll, would need to stake proportionally more tokens. As the number of fake identities grows, so does the cost, making it as impractical as trying to dam the entire ocean. Upon reaching a validation summit, honest agents can collectively verify and penalize malicious actors, thereby securing the network.
